# Field Treatment Mixing
In the field you can mix your own dressings from a base and an ingredient, instead of carrying every kind of dressing ready-made.
## Mixing - Press [keybind="CMUOpenMedicalCraftingMenu"] to open the medical crafting menu. It shows everything you can mix with what you're carrying. - Each dressing uses one base and some units of one ingredient. - [bold]Packed gauze[/bold] makes a gauze dressing. [bold]Packed trauma kits[/bold] make a full trauma dressing. - Both bases can also be used on their own to control bleeding. See [textlink="Wounds and Bleeding" link="CMUGuideMedicalWounds"].
## Ingredients - [bold]Coagulant powder[/bold]: clotting agent. Makes hemostatic gauze, or a trauma kit from a packed trauma kit. - [bold]Burn gel[/bold]: cooling gel. Makes burn gauze, or a burn kit from a packed trauma kit. - [bold]Antiseptic[/bold]: makes antiseptic dressings, which clean contaminated wounds. - [bold]Tissue sealant[/bold]: makes sealing dressings, which help wounds close. - [bold]Trauma foam[/bold]: makes compression dressings.
